tasks.title: Debug overlay script (SAM bboxes rendered on mockup)
tasks.notes: DONE. scripts/debug-video-boxes.mjs — pure-local transform over ai-video-mockup.sam.json, emits ai-video-mockup.overlay.svg with per-key colored outline rects + labels (idx:key WxH score). Env-var overrides (SAM_JSON/MOCKUP_PNG/OVERLAY_SVG) so the acceptance test runs against a synthetic fixture. Embeds mockup as a data: URI backdrop so the overlay is self-contained. Pattern adapted from scripts/debug-scifi-boxes.mjs (sibling emits PNG; this emits SVG per task contract). verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T-SWAP-03 test OK. Test-regex note: original test used a combined regex whose trailing `<?` consumed the next `<text>` opener (masked a false negative). Fix uses two separate regexes; contract coverage unchanged. SHOULD FIX (from spec-reviewer, for downstream): (a) rect objects carry an unused `i` field post-sort — drop it since `.map((r, idx) => ...)` shadows with a fresh post-sort index, avoid source-of-truth ambiguity in T-SWAP-04's BBOX hand-tune; (b) progress-log touch happens in step-12 commit (per repo pattern aced8de/dff44ce), not in this impl commit — if Ralph wrapper skips it, graduates to MUST FIX. OPTIONAL (from spec-reviewer): (c) COLOR_BY_KEY `?? '#ff0000'` fallback is unreachable today but silently paints all drift-keys red; a console.warn would fail loud on future PROMPTS edits; (d) SVG `<text>` inner does not XML-escape r.key — safe under the closed 11-noun allowlist from segment-video.mjs, but `.replace(/[&<>]/g, ...)` would future-proof if the key source ever broadens; (e) data-URI backdrop inflates overlay SVG to ~1.3× mockup PNG size (~8–9 MB for the 2816×1536 AETHER source) — `href="ai-video-mockup.png"` relative ref would keep SVG ~10 KB and still render from the mockup-candidates/ dir; (f) paired-rect regex in test only matches self-closing `<rect .../>`; `<rect ...></rect>` form would silently degrade pairing to zero — `<rect\b[^>]*(?:\/>|><\/rect>)` more robust. Note: script has NOT yet been run against a real sam.json — ai-video-mockup.sam.json does not exist on disk (segment-video.mjs from T-SWAP-02 was written but not executed). T-SWAP-04 should either run segment-video.mjs or skip to hand-tuned BBOX, then run debug-video-boxes.mjs for QA.

SHOULD FIX carried forward for downstream: (a) isLegacyBaseDir regex fails on trailing-slash form (e.g. CUTOUT_DIR=.../base/) — path.basename() normalization is safer (today resolve() strips trailing slash for the default path, so only affects callers passing raw strings); (b) T-SWAP-06 downstream: home-hub.json node entries absent from the AETHER mockup need the TINY invisible-placeholder; alpha-cutout's 'tiny placeholder' width<3 guard already skips them, but extract-video.mjs does not yet emit them (TRANSPARENT_PNG branch unused). OPTIONAL: (h) PLACEHOLDER literal {-1,-1,2,2} could share with TINY in extract-video.mjs via scripts/lib/placeholder.mjs; (i) writeFileSync UTF-8 encoding + LF lock-in for Windows autocrlf defense; (j) console.log leading tag to match sibling script style. tasks.notes: DONE. build-atlas.mjs now globs cropped/*.png and classifies them with literal 'cropped/<basename>.png' assetKeys matching the home-hub.json visual.sourceAsset strings post T-SWAP-06; a synthesizer at the end of main() appends 2×2 transparent in-memory regions for every graph node whose sourceAsset starts with 'cropped/' but has no matching file on disk (the 30 invisible-placeholder nodes from T-SWAP-06, all with transform (-1,-1,2,2) per CLAUDE.md §-IMAGE-TO-UI). build-prism.mjs strips the 'cropped/' prefix + '.png' suffix from `asset` before forming per-state lookup keys so `notifications-toggle`'s regionKeys resolve against states/ (`notifications-toggle-off`, `notifications-toggle-on`) unchanged. Atlas region count 68→130 (32 real cropped + 30 synth placeholders + 24 frames + 2 states + 2 overlays + 40 legacy base retained for back-compat; legacy base regions are orphans today but not referenced by the hub). Rebuilt artifacts: atlas-0.avif 987748 B, bin utilization 37.3%, artifactHash 8d5b6752f650df5f34325071d589bfb5b43c3112808912f1baf51c234c5ffcf6 reproducible across two consecutive builds. verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T-SWAP-07 test OK (includes zero-orphans + §3.1/§10.19 layout + determinism under VERIFY_BUILD_REPRODUCIBILITY=1). Spec-reviewer: no deviations found. SHOULD FIX carried forward to downstream: (a) all 30 synthesized placeholders share one identical hash in atlas-regions.json — per-region `hash` no longer uniquely identifies content; hash `assetKey` into the placeholder hash for uniqueness; (b) build-atlas synthesizer runs two sequential sharp pipelines (PNG → raw) for a 2×2 buffer — single `sharp({create:...}).raw().ensureAlpha().toBuffer({resolveWithObject:true})` avoids the PNG round-trip; (c) the `cropped/`-strip transform is duplicated in build-atlas classifySource + build-prism stateKey — lift into scripts/lib/asset-key.mjs before the next source-dir addition drifts the two sites apart; (d) CLAUDE.md `All commits that change source must also touch notes/prism-mock-progress.md` — this impl commit did not; the progress-log touch lands in step-12's separate commit per Ralph convention, but enforcement could graduate to MUST FIX if that step is ever skipped; (e) manifest.createdAt and meta/generator.json.builtAt both embed fresh timestamps per build — `artifactHash` excludes them (neither is in entries[]) so the contracted reproducibility holds, but full-zip byte-determinism is blocked by these two fields if §10.19 ever demands that stricter invariant. OPTIONAL (from spec-reviewer): (f) log-line punctuation style inconsistency in build-atlas; (g) mirror the per-dir assetKey-shape comment block from build-atlas into build-prism so state-key strip logic is navigable without round-tripping files; (h) `n.visual?.sourceAsset ?? n.nodeId` fallback in the synthesizer's loop is dead code given the `cropped/` prefix guard rejects nodeId-only values — drop the ?? branch. tasks.notes: DONE (already-satisfied branch of /ralph-step step 6). (B) correctly fails against a bogus URL (demonstrated with PRISM_LIVE_URL=.../does-not-exist-404-page-T-SWAP-08 → exit 1). SKIP_LIVE_SMOKE=1 collapses the test to (A) only for offline debugging. SHOULD FIX carried forward for downstream: (a) the SKIP_LIVE_SMOKE=1 bypass contradicts the test's own comment claiming the gate is not opt-in — a stray env var in CI silently weakens the §10.24 gate to 5 string matches; either remove the bypass or rename to OFFLINE_DEBUG_ONLY + assert at the three-gate runner layer that SKIP_LIVE_SMOKE !== '1'; (b) the canonical prod URL `https://kid-kode-ai-landing.vercel.app/` is hardcoded in 3 places (scripts/live-modes-smoke.mjs:13, scripts/live-vercel-smoke.mjs:15, tests/swap/T-SWAP-08.test.mjs:45) — a Vercel project rename silently hits the wrong URL; lift into scripts/lib/prod-url.mjs and import; (c) the playwright-import regex `/await\s+import\s*\(\s*['"]playwright['"]\s*\)/` only matches the dynamic `await import('playwright')` form used today — a refactor to static ESM `import { chromium } from 'playwright'` would silently pass the gate; broaden to also match `chromium.launch(` as evidence the runner wires Playwright; (d) REQUIRED_CHECKS and STATIC_LITERAL_CHECKS are siblings without a cross-check — an accidental edit that drops `split.restored` from one but not both silently weakens the gate; add `assert.equal(new Set([...REQUIRED_CHECKS]).size, 8)` + assert `STATIC_LITERAL_CHECKS ∪ {preset.{mobile,tablet,desktop}.canvas-dims} === REQUIRED_CHECKS`; (e) phaseCaps.§1 entry in state-claim commit b6d280f doesn't match the existing §-IMAGE-TO-UI / §-SPEC-ENRICH / §-HOUSEKEEPING convention and T-SWAP-08's specRef is §10.24 not §1 — likely absorbed tail bookkeeping; revert or rename to §-SHIP/§10; (f) state-claim commit b6d280f also absorbed iter-7's checkpoint.commit/verifiedAt/recordedAt + convergence.lastProductiveCommit updates that should have landed in iter-7-done commit a48bc87 — muddles the audit trail of which iteration wrote which field, no value impact. tasks.title: Add interactive-element classifier note to prism-spec-extract.md
tasks.notes: DONE. Appended new `## §-SPEC-ENRICH — INTERACTIVE-ELEMENT CLASSIFIER PASS (Design Note)` section to prism-spec-extract.md (before SPECIFICATION AMBIGUITIES, ~50 lines). Section covers: (A) heading presence; (B) post-segmentation pipeline position with ASCII diagram showing segment-video.mjs → [classifier] → debug-video-boxes.mjs → extract-video.mjs → patch-home-hub-for-mockup.mjs; (C) vision-model (VLM) classifier shape — explicit rejection of hand-coded pixel rules, hardcoded heuristics, and hardcoded nodeId allowlists (rationale: T-VID-01 debate + editor-genericity rule); (D) user-supplied vs auto-generated branch, default user-supplied, auto requires explicit user approval (T-VID-03 cost gate); (E) `{event, effect, src}` emission shape with `src` explicitly ratified as a *permitted extension* to the canonical {event, effect} tuple at line 626 — additive, not rename; (F) forward reference to T-VID-03 as the task that wires the generation half.
